AL-AMEEN IMAGE GUIDE
====================
Drop your photos into these folders using EXACTLY these file names.
Until a file exists, the site shows a clean dark panel with an icon, so nothing breaks.
Use JPG or WebP, under 400 KB each (compress at squoosh.app). Use photos you own or
have permission to use. Do not copy pictures from other websites.

hero/hero.jpg                    1920x1080   Paver or crew at work (home page background)
about/office.jpg                 1200x900    Your office (About page)
about/team.jpg                   1200x900    Team on site (Home and About)
construction/road.jpg            1200x900    Road construction
construction/infrastructure.jpg  1200x900    Bridge or civil works
construction/building.jpg        1200x900    Building project
construction/site.jpg            1200x900    Site development
equipment/paver.jpg              1200x900    Paver machine
equipment/grader.jpg             1200x900    Grader
equipment/payloader.jpg          1200x900    Payloader
equipment/roller.jpg             1200x900    Roller
equipment/backhoe.jpg            1200x900    Backhoe
equipment/tarboiler.jpg          1200x900    Tarboiler
materials/bitumen.jpg            1200x900    Bitumen drums or tanker
materials/trucks.jpg             1200x900    Trucks for sale
materials/machines.jpg           1200x900    Machines and autos for sale
projects/project-1.jpg ... project-4.jpg   1200x900   One per project in siteData.js
news/news-1.jpg ... news-3.jpg              1200x900   One per news item in siteData.js
team/leader-1.jpg                800x1000    Portraits, if you add leaders in siteData.js

To use a different file name, change the path in src/data/siteData.js.
